column5: Stycast 2850FT with catalyst 23LV, resin:hardener mass 100:7.5. The commercial alumina-filled formulation remains distinct from the additional lamp-black mixture in sample B. Samples were hand mixed for more than 20 min, vacuum degassed without dropping below approximately 50 Torr during preparation, then oven cured according to manufacturer recommendations. Exact cure temperature/duration are not published. Approximately 10 mg samples were measured by PPMS relaxation calorimetry under vacuum, with 2-3 percent temperature pulses and measured addenda subtraction. Absolute measurement pressure and Cp-versus-Cv constraint are not specified. This is the actual reported cured population, not any same-name producer datasheet specimen.
